subtitle: Using a snapshot's history — not re-teaching how it's built

code:
-- WRONG: multiplies every order
select o.order_id, c.region
from fct_orders o
join customers_snapshot c
  on o.customer_id = c.customer_id
caption: No effective-dating condition — every order fans out to every historical version.

code:
select o.order_id, o.order_total,
  c.region as region_at_time_of_order
from fct_orders o
join customers_snapshot c
  on o.customer_id = c.customer_id
 and o.order_date >= c.dbt_valid_from
 and (o.order_date < c.dbt_valid_to
      or c.dbt_valid_to is null)
caption: The region that was true when the sale happened — not today's region.

code:
-- dim_customers_current.sql
select *
from customers_snapshot
where dbt_valid_to is null
caption: Filter to current once — every other model joins like an ordinary dimension.
